alert: Loom step slots idle with work waiting

A.name: A
A.query:
WITH
  toInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}) AS end_ms,
  series AS (
    SELECT fingerprint,
           any(if(JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name') != '', JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name'), JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.id'))) AS host,
           any(JSONExtractString(labels, 'state')) AS state,
           any(JSONExtractString(labels, 'role')) AS role,
           any(JSONExtractString(labels, 'pool')) AS pool
    FROM signoz_metrics.time_series_v4
    WHERE metric_name IN ('loom.forge.stage_items', 'loom.dispatch.busy_slots', 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent')
    GROUP BY fingerprint
  ),
  pts AS (
    SELECT series.host AS host, series.state AS state, series.role AS role, series.pool AS pool,
           s.metric_name AS metric, s.unix_milli AS ms, s.value AS value
    FROM signoz_metrics.samples_v4 AS s
    INNER JOIN series USING (fingerprint)
    WHERE s.metric_name IN ('loom.forge.stage_items', 'loom.dispatch.busy_slots', 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent')
      AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}}
      AND s.unix_milli < {{.end_timestamp_ms}}
  ),
  depth_at AS (
    SELECT host, ms, sum(value) AS depth
    FROM pts
    WHERE metric = 'loom.forge.stage_items' AND state IN ('triage', 'unlabeled', 'curated_not_promoted', 'issue_no_pr')
    GROUP BY host, ms
  ),
  depth AS (
    SELECT host, min(depth) AS min_depth FROM depth_at GROUP BY host
  ),
  slots AS (
    SELECT host,
           maxIf(value, metric = 'loom.dispatch.busy_slots' AND role = 'sweep' AND pool = '') AS busy,
           maxIf(value, metric = 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent') AS max_concurrent,
           minIf(ms, metric = 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent') AS first_ms
    FROM pts
    WHERE host != ''
    GROUP BY host
  )
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(end_ms, 1000)) AS ts,
       slots.host AS host,
       slots.busy / slots.max_concurrent AS value
FROM slots
INNER JOIN depth ON depth.host = slots.host
WHERE slots.max_concurrent > 0
  AND depth.min_depth > 0
  AND slots.first_ms <= {{.start_timestamp_ms}} + 300000
ORDER BY host

annotations.summary: Loom step slots idle with work waiting
annotations.description: Host {{$labels.host}} never filled half its slots in 30 min: the most busy step slots it reported (loom.dispatch.busy_slots role=sweep) were {{$value}} of loom.dispatch.max_concurrent, while every loom.forge.stage_items sample in the window showed work waiting (triage, unlabeled, curated_not_promoted, issue_no_pr). Look at pick.decision item_draw exclusions (cooling_down, pool_exhausted, build_backoff) and at loom.dispatch.step refusals. Issue rjwalters/loom#11909.
